Summary: God's command to Jeremiah: arise, go down to the potter's house, and there hear God's words.
Commandment: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
Application: A deed-commission, not a speech alone: Jeremiah must go to the place before he hears the word, and the potter's vessel becomes the sermon (Jeremiah 18:3-10). Generic prophetic 'speak to this people' commissions are not separately rowed (see notes); this one is included because the commanded journey and object lesson are a distinct act.
Purpose: To show Jeremiah, in the potter's work, that Israel is clay in the LORD's hand — to be remade or ruined as he speaks (Jeremiah 18:6-10).
